title: Lease Break Liability Settings of the Lease Term Agreement Programs
content:
Resident accounting keeps four settings per Lease Term Agreement program for an exit that ends a term early: the program's reletting fee rate, whether a resident who breaks the lease stays liable for rent until the apartment home is re-leased or the term ends, whether rent billed for days a replacement resident also pays for is credited back, and whether the unearned part of a move-in concession is recaptured when the term ends early.

| Term program | Reletting fee rate (fraction of the contracted monthly rent) | Lease-break rent liability | Reletting credit | Concession recapture |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Month-to-Month Agreement | 0.00 | No | No | No |
| Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) | 0.5 (50 percent) | Yes | Yes | No |
| Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) | 0.7 (70 percent) | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Standard Lease (10-12 Months) | 0.85 (85 percent) | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Extended Lease (13-15 Months) | 0.85 (85 percent) | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) | 1.00 (100 percent) | Yes | Yes | Yes |

**Column meanings.** The reletting fee rate is a fraction of the contracted monthly rent. Lease-break rent liability Yes keeps the resident liable for rent until the apartment home is re-leased or the term ends. Reletting credit Yes credits back rent billed for days a replacement resident also pays for. Concession recapture Yes means the unearned part of a move-in concession is recaptured when the term ends early; No means it is not.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) program at a reletting fee rate of 0.7 applied to a hypothetical contracted rent of 2,000.00 dollars gives 1,400.00 dollars; a Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) program at 1.00 gives the full 2,000.00 dollars.
